top_signal.title: 5 years might be it
top_signal.summary: My business makes 5 years on the 22nd of this month. I really wanted it to be a joyful and positive moment but I was met with “we practically have no money in the account” I own a bowling alley with a full restaurant, Arcade and indoor play park( newest of the areas). I’ve fought so hard to offer something different to the public where I live. I’m about 700k in debt still with this project and don’t know what to do. We’ve organized events, family promos, we have a strong social media presence (not saying that means anything but the interactions always seem positive) but we haven’t been able to get over the hump, I’ve analyzed all my overhead and kept my food costs in check, I simply just need to get more people through the door and can’t seem to do that. I have 35 members on my team and I can help but feel like I’m letting everyone down. I love my business, I love my community, I just don’t know what to do anymore.        submitted by     /u/Howinthe_world       [link]       [comments]
